semantics.function: Both outputs equal the AND of a and b.
semantics.timing: Combinational; outputs follow current inputs after combinational settling, with no clock-cycle latency or storage.
semantics.initialization: No explicit initialization or persistent state; outputs derive from current inputs.

numeric.arithmetic: No addition, overflow, rounding, saturation or truncation.
numeric.four_state: Use standard SystemVerilog bitwise AND propagation for X/Z; original problem specifies binary AND behavior.

verification.independent_oracle: Explicit binary truth table, not a copy of the DUT expression.
verification.coverage: Exhaust all four binary input pairs and all ordered transitions; check both outputs after settling. Supplement with standard four-state AND truth-table checks.
verification.tools: Icarus v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; compile and simulation each under finite timeout.
verification.acceptance: All checks pass with an explicit PASS marker; any mismatch is fatal.
verification.scope: Local development verification only; no official evaluation, synthesis or board testing.
